topic.title: Health: A dentist visits villages to help teeth
topic.focus: A dentist visits villages to help teeth

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: Teeth are a problem in villages
sections.text: In 2010, Dr. Priya is a dentist. She works in a big city. But she sees that people in villages have very bad teeth. They cannot go to a dentist. The village is far away. Dr. Priya wants to help.

sections.heading: A mobile clinic
sections.text: In 2012, Dr. Priya buys a small van. She puts a dentist chair and tools inside. Every month, she drives to a village. She treats 30 to 50 people a day. She fixes teeth. She pulls bad teeth. She teaches people how to keep teeth clean.

sections.heading: Children learn about teeth
sections.text: Dr. Priya teaches children in village schools. She shows them how to brush their teeth. She teaches them not to eat too much sugar. The children love the lessons. They show their parents what they learn. Soon, more people take care of their teeth.

sections.heading: Villages on a schedule
sections.text: Now Dr. Priya visits 12 villages every month. She has a schedule. Village A is on Monday, Village B on Tuesday. People know when she is coming. They save money to pay for treatment. The treatment is cheap. Everyone can afford it.

sections.heading: Smiles across the villages
sections.text: After 12 years, Dr. Priya has helped 10,000 people. Children have fewer cavities. Adults smile more now. Dr. Priya says teeth health is important health. When people feel good about their teeth, they feel good about everything.

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — Teeth are a problem in villages
In 2010, Dr. Priya is a dentist. She works in a big city. But she sees that people in villages have very bad teeth. They cannot go to a dentist. The village is far away. Dr. Priya wants to help.

Paragraph 2 — A mobile clinic
In 2012, Dr. Priya buys a small van. She puts a dentist chair and tools inside. Every month, she drives to a village. She treats 30 to 50 people a day. She fixes teeth. She pulls bad teeth. She teaches people how to keep teeth clean.

Paragraph 3 — Children learn about teeth
Dr. Priya teaches children in village schools. She shows them how to brush their teeth. She teaches them not to eat too much sugar. The children love the lessons. They show their parents what they learn. Soon, more people take care of their teeth.

Paragraph 4 — Villages on a schedule
Now Dr. Priya visits 12 villages every month. She has a schedule. Village A is on Monday, Village B on Tuesday. People know when she is coming. They save money to pay for treatment. The treatment is cheap. Everyone can afford it.

Paragraph 5 — Smiles across the villages
After 12 years, Dr. Priya has helped 10,000 people. Children have fewer cavities. Adults smile more now. Dr. Priya says teeth health is important health. When people feel good about their teeth, they feel good about everything.
